answer.handoff: Update app.signup to accept an optional phone field and validate it only when present: require ASCII digits matching 010 followed by 8 digits, and raise ValueError before any database write or event emission if invalid. Keep missing phone allowed. Persist the phone in SQLite alongside existing user fields, while preserving the current name behavior, explicit allowed-field handling, owner authorization, and parameterized SQL. Ensure app.profile continues to return phone only on the existing owner-only read path. Keep the signup event flow intact, but do not include raw phone in telemetry or error output. Make the init migration idempotent so existing users remain preserved. This fixture is SQLite-only and should not add production encryption, phone verification, or HTTP endpoint changes.
